physical_entity_node_group_memberships.qualification_evidence: The Big Hill / Terril de Lubumbashi is a historic copper-cobalt smelter slag heap of roughly 10-14 Mt that carries recoverable germanium (alongside zinc, copper, cobalt and rare metals); it is the host accumulation feeding STL's germanium recovery.

owners.ownership_type: State mining company (owner of the slag resource)
owners.source_or_evidence: The Lubumbashi slag heap is a legacy Gécamines asset.

operators.organization_name: Société pour le Traitement du Terril de Lubumbashi (STL)
operators.operator_relationship_type: Processing operator working the slag under agreement
operators.source_or_evidence: STL reclaims and treats the Big Hill slag.

identity.facility_name: Big Hill Slag Dump (Terril de Lubumbashi)
identity.short_description: Legacy copper-cobalt smelter slag heap in Lubumbashi (~10-14 Mt) that hosts recoverable germanium; the primary feed source for STL's germanium recovery plant and, downstream, Umicore.
identity.commissioning_or_operating_start_date: Accumulated over 20th-century Cu-Co smelting; reclamation-era from ~1990s

operations.operating_configuration: Single-site slag accumulation feeding an adjacent reclamation/hydrometallurgical plant

operations.main_physical_function: Hosts germanium-bearing copper-cobalt smelter slag and supplies reclaimed slag as feedstock to germanium recovery

major_industrial_processes.transformation_function: Excavation and reclamation of the historic slag heap
major_industrial_processes.actual_process_or_technology_used: Mechanical excavation / reclamation of the terril

operation_metrics.quantity_basis: Slag reclaimed and fed to recovery

operations.estimation_method: Public reporting on the Lubumbashi slag heap resource
